title: Scenario grader: a 403 on an operation whose declared outcome is applied is charged to the operation, not to the build that denied it
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filed by eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn.

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M1), quoted there; also ① grader defect, measured. `reach:` eval#1 round 1, 2026-11-14 (control cards, scratch, published 18.4.0, runner at objectstack `d683e6f3`, model claude-fable-5-1).

## What happened

- `invoice_with_line_items` op `add_line` as `sales_rep` (declared `applied`): answer `refused PERMISSION_DENIED (403)`, 0 writes. Graded as an operation failure.
- `project_with_tasks` ops `add_task` (`applied`), `drop_packing` (`pending_confirmation`) and `task_without_title` (`write_validation`) as `contractor`: all `refused PERMISSION_DENIED (403)`; the validation half could not be measured because the probe also met 403.
- Build scored 32/32 and 30/30 on those cards. 4 of the 7 operation points lost that round were the built app's permission set, not the agent.

## Carrier

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-operation-grade.ts` grades the observed answer against the declared outcome; `isProbedOperation` (`src/schema.ts`, used in `src/score/index.ts`) probes only `refused` creates and updates.
- The runner's own probe (`src/runner/observe.ts`) already writes as the persona through the same MCP door.

## Done when

_Edited by epic:#33595#1: the `pending_confirmation` half of item 1 is dropped (premise correction 6887999657: an agent write attempt is that outcome's own failure; on `delete_record` a 403 follows only an agent-sent `confirm: true`). A `pending_confirmation` operation grades as today._

- For an operation declared `applied`, the runner sends the declared write itself as the persona; when the platform answers 403 the operation is **not measured: the build denies the persona this write**, and the scorecard carries a Build finding naming persona, object and verb.
- The `write_validation` probe that meets the build's 403 is reported the same way when the card gives that persona the write (today `buildLockOf` covers only a locked field plus a declared action).
- A test pins each case on a recorded fixture; a 403 the card declares (`refused PERMISSION_DENIED`) still grades as today.

## Reader

The epic PM of #33595 dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`). eval#1 replays the recorded runs at M1 close-out.

Dedup: see #33595 (no duplicate; #33414 #33415 #33256 are other grader defects, all closed).
